item.title: 评论: Traffic gridlock at Malaysia-Singapore causeway after Woodlands blackout
item.description: A massive power outage at the Woodlands checkpoint in Singapore caused a heavy traffic jam on most major roads leading to the Malaysian checkpoint in Johor Bahru on Wednesday. Although all counters were operating at optimum level at the Bangunan Sultan Iskandar Customs, Immigration and Quarantine complex in the southern state of Johor, the jam lasted for many hours due to a build-up of vehicles from the Singapore side. item.title: 评论: “十五五”末中国社会消费品零售总额预计达60万亿元左右
item.description: 中新社北京11月4日电 (记者 王梦瑶)中国国家发改委经济贸易司副司长寇荣4日在北京表示，预计到“十五五”末，中国流通业整体规模将持续扩大，社会消费品零售总额达到60万亿元人民币左右；流通网络将更加健全，102个现代流通战略支点城市辐射带动能力进一步增强，将有6条国家级重要商品骨干流通走廊落地建设。

item.title: 评论: “十五五”时期中国将新建约1.5万公里铁路
item.description: 中新社北京11月4日电 (记者 王梦瑶)中国国家发改委基础设施发展司司长夏鑫4日在北京表示，“十五五”时期，中国将新建约1.5万公里铁路，其中包括约1万公里高速铁路，基本实现铁路现代化目标。

item.title: 评论: Needles, nails, pins found in Halloween sweets across Austria, Germany
item.description: Austrian police have launched an investigation after small metal objects such as nails, needles and pins were found in Halloween sweets at several locations across the country. Police received 13 reports of metal objects found in sweets collected by children at Halloween, federal criminal police said in a statement on Wednesday. item.title: 评论: India vows to dig its way out of China machinery curbs
item.description: India’s ambitious plans to construct high-speed railways, metro networks and strategic roads through the Himalayas could be hampered by China’s proposed restrictions on tunnel-boring machines, exposing a dependence on foreign technology that New Delhi may find difficult to overcome.
